rawRecord.short_description: Encrypted read/write access to Standard Notes vaults with local-only decryption via stdio.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Enables AI agents to read and write Standard Notes while preserving end-to-end encryption. Decryption happens locally using libsodium with credentials stored in the OS keychain, never transmitted remotely. Provides tools for listing, searching, creating, updating, and deleting notes and tags, with vault sync and statistics.
